actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: No resident contributed >30 in the last round and wallet (0.18) is below the free‑rider threshold, so I cannot contribute the minimum 1 unit and must rest, while still broadcasting a discouraging message.

Broadcast discouraging large contributions.
